The standard POSIX way to detect a debugger is to attempt to call `ptrace()` on the process. However, this must be done from a child process, rather than from the process itself, to allow attaching to it later if desired, making the approach relatively heavy. On Windows, `as_bytes()` panics when `OsStr` contains invalid Unicode. To avoid this, we use a Windows-specific starts-with function that does not rely on `as_bytes()`. <summary>
  <para>Builds a <see cref="Policy{TResult}" /> that functions like a circuit breaker.</para>
  <para>The circuit breaks if, within any timeslice of duration <paramref name="samplingDuration" />, the proportion of actions resulting in a handled exception or result exceeds <paramref name="failureThreshold" />, provided that the number of actions passing through the circuit during the timeslice is at least <paramref name="minimumThroughput" />.</para>
  <para>The circuit remains broken for <paramref name="durationOfBreak" />. Any attempt to execute this policy while the circuit is broken immediately throws a <see cref="BrokenCircuitException" /> containing the exception or result that broke the circuit.</para>
  <para>If the first action after the break duration results in a handled exception or result, the circuit breaks again for another <paramref name="durationOfBreak" />. If no exception or handled result is encountered, the circuit resets.</para>
</summary>
<typeparam name="TResult">The return type of delegates that may be executed through the policy.</typeparam>
<param name="policyBuilder">The policy builder.</param>
<param name="failureThreshold">The failure threshold at which the circuit breaks. This value must be between 0 and 1; e.g., 0.5 represents breaking if 50% or more of the actions result in a handled failure.</param>
<param name="samplingDuration">The duration of the timeslice over which failure ratios are assessed.</param>
<param name="minimumThroughput">The minimum throughput: this many actions or more must pass through the circuit during the timeslice for the statistics to be considered significant and the circuit breaker to take action.</param>
<param name="durationOfBreak">The duration for which the circuit remains open before resetting.</param>
<param name="onBreak">The action to call when the circuit transitions to an <see cref="CircuitState.Open" /> state.</param>
<param name="onReset">The action to call when the circuit resets to a <see cref="CircuitState.Closed" /> state.</param>
<param name="onHalfOpen">The action to call when the circuit transitions to a <see cref="CircuitState.HalfOpen" /> state, ready to try action executions again.</param>
<returns>The policy instance.</returns>
<exception cref="ArgumentOutOfRangeException">failureThreshold; Value must be greater than zero.</exception>
<exception cref="ArgumentOutOfRangeException">failureThreshold; Value must be less than or equal to one.</exception>
